cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your paper cloud made a drop. Put a tray underneath; we'll have a demonstration for the school show.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it really rain? Everyone laughed at rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One drop is a start. Hold the cloud level, please; let me arrange the collection tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your wet cuff is dripping onto it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your eyes on the cloud; you're tilting it. I'll deal with the damp sleeve. Put the tray under that corner and we'll catch the next drop.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3/A5 manage a demonstration and divert from the wet cuff, but a paper cloud dripping is not yet a clearly impossible outcome.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 cuff exposure to redirect eyes and prepare another collection, but the scale of hoped-for rain is unclear.

specificity.evidence: A1 paper-cloud school show could simply be a wet-paper demonstration rather than impossible weather-making.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 holds several instructions, all related to collection, but the intended impossible success needs clarity.
